page.metamorphosisDescription: Each piece passes through meticulous hand-shaping, resin casting, and diamond-grit restoration over weeks of controlled curing.
page.step1Body: We carefully source aged timber with irregular sapwood. The resin is poured at room temperature in multiple layers, allowing artisans to suspend pigment swirls that hold their vortex structure as the resin solidifies without air pocket entrapment.
page.step2Body: Designed for luxury entertaining and delicate handling. Hand-wash with tepid water and gentle plant soap. Recondition edges every 3–4 months with the complimentary Galassia elixir to preserve grain depth.

emerald-gold-vein-board.availability: Galassia operates exclusively on direct atelier client reservations. No automated checkouts — we coordinate shipping crates, protective packing, and bespoke delivery personally.
